Nora El-Badawi: Hi team! I'm Nora, joining as Infra SRE today. Quick intro — previously at a payments startup, I love espresso shots & tiny succulents. Day-one asks: who to ping for MDM laptop imaging, when will VPN access arrive, and is there a team lunch today? Also looking for a buddy. Thanks! :wave:
Samir Patel: Welcome Nora!! I'm your buddy — Samir. Ping me for ssh/vpn. I can meet 11:30 PT for a quick sync? :coffee:
Chris (eng-manager): Welcome aboard! MDM is handled by Mira in People Ops. I'll DM you the infra onboarding checklist. Our VPN uses 'redwood-vpn' — you should get an invite in ~15-60m; if not, ping @Mira.
Mira (people-ops): hi Nora — sending MDM invite + asset intake form now. For laptop imaging, reply to the ticket with your mac serial / PC asset id. Also tell us shirt/hoodie sizes, and we'll ship a welcome pack :package: 
Nora El-Badawi: thanks Samir and Mira! my laptop serial is C02XQ0ABC123. Mac is preferred. I'll take the 11:30 sync, Samir.
Samir Patel: Awesome. For SSH you can add your public key via the portal: https://intranet.redwood/ssh-keys
Samir Patel: Quick snippet if you need to generate a key:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "nora@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Nora El-Badawi: got it, uploading key now. Also coffee prefs: oat milk + single espresso :relieved:
Chris (eng-manager): We do a team lunch on Wednesdays; this week's lunch is pizza. Welcome lunch at 12:30 PT — I'll add you to infra and eng-oncall channels.
deploy-bot: Deployment notice: infra-config updated by chris at 5201112500 — no downtime expected :robot_face:
Mira (people-ops): swag Qs — tee size small or medium? hoodie size? any dietary restrictions?
Nora El-Badawi: small tee, hoodie M. No dietary restrictions. Fun fact: I tinker with vintage espresso machines in my garage :nerd_face:
Samir Patel: Love that. Calendar invite sent for 11:30. If VPN doesn't arrive in an hour, ping me or @Mira and I'll escalate.
Nora El-Badawi: thanks everyone! excited to be here :tada:
